decisions.design: Agreed with the Guardian before building (answers A to D). A new append-only event table instead of reusing offline revocation, which cannot be undone and hides the request from its owner. Withdrawn now is the newest event by sequence number; offline revocation stays separate and stronger, so a revoked request can be neither withdrawn nor restored.
decisions.authority: Only the owning principal (same subject and issuer). Anyone else, and an unknown request, get the same refusal. One command id per decision: a repeat answers with how things stand now; the same id for another decision or request is refused the same way (a concurrent reuse is mapped to the same 42501).
decisions.when: Any time until the team has closed or cancelled the mission (CLOSED or CANCELLED answer not-withdrawable). Withdrawing deletes nothing, so after delivery it is allowed and delivered reports stay readable to the owner. Withdrawing needs the control open; restoring never does, so a paused control can never trap a withdrawal.
decisions.team: No customer function writes the team's mission. The team sees nothing in this PR; S4's follow-up shows 'Withdrawn by the customer on <date>' read only. The owner should not open the control until that is merged.
decisions.reason: 10 to 500 characters of the person's own words. Stored only in the private event table, returned only to its owner, never in the domain event payload, the audit trail or an error. Whether the team may read it later is an owner privacy decision; exposing it is one function change. The dialog says plainly: 'Only you can see this reason; the Corridra team sees that you withdrew the request and when.'
decisions.outbound: A withdrawn request sends no mission mail and no Pulse message. A message is blocked if the request was withdrawn at any time since the message (or the Move) was made, or is now, or is muted; the Move enqueue checks after both advisory locks; the claim checks again with the message's own creation time. Restoring never sends or queues anything, and a mute and a withdrawal together answer withdrawn.
decisions.installOrder: The withdrawal module needs no mail module. Mission mail 0003 and notifications 0005 need the withdrawal module and stop with a clear message without it. The mail and Pulse install runners do not install it for you.
decisions.undo: Ten seconds of Undo after withdrawing, then Restore Request on the Withdrawn filter at any time while the request is not revoked.
decisions.process: The database module and its tests were written together and shown to fail with the migration directory removed; the Move and mail effects were tested after the guards; the lock of the in-flight dialog was proven by removing it, which failed its test. The browser spec was written after the component.
